summary: @TheJLV this does not mean silos are bad, they can be entry points into wonderful networks. I also wonder if we should really be asking, "If we paid our teachers enough would they feel compelled to seek a route to monetization?"
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @TheJLV this does not mean silos are bad, they can be entry points into wonderful networks. I also wonder if we should really be asking, "If we paid our teachers enough would they feel compelled to seek a route to monetization?"
